Vector geometry from `logseq/logseq`, `src/main/frontend/components/svg.cljs`, `logo`.
128 pt canvas, with padding around the original 21 × 21 view box. Light: theme gray (`#6F6F6F`); dark: Logseq cyan (`#85c8c8`).
Both appearances use 65% opacity, shared by the system launch screen and the in-app transition.
